fields.description: Issue includes New Year’s Eve-themed editorials and commentary on Miami’s prospects for 1928, local civic concerns (including parking privileges and traffic/safety islands), and discussion of tourism and business conditions in Greater Miami. Coverage also references entertainment and nightlife venues, transportation developments (including Miami Beach access and Collins avenue), and local sports and recreation, alongside regular columns, notices, and advertisements.
